description: A world border 16 across around the origin (x and z from -8 to 8): walking east into it (stopped at x 7.7), sprint-jumping into it, walking north-east along it (sliding north); with stone in hand, an attack and a use on the floor block just outside it (refused: nothing sent) and a use on the one inside it; a bed aimed so its head would go outside (not placed); a still pig outside it used (nothing sent). Then it shrinks to 10 over 40 ticks with the player crouching at x 7 (left outside; it stands once the border is more than a block away), who walks back in and east into it again; it grows to 20 over 20 ticks while the player walks east, and its centre moves to x 3. Back at the origin and 15 across (x to 7.5): walking east stops at x 7.7, past the border line, at the edge of the whole blocks it covers; crouching there, it is set to 14 (the player's centre outside it, within a block): let go of sneak, the player can't stand and crawls; crawling back in, it stands; reset.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:stone 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:red_bed 1
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
